contributions.detail: The single Schedule A row is 5,746.16 = the schedule's printed page subtotal = its printed Total Contributions Received = the promoted PER-PERIOD cell Box B. Box C (Year to Date) prints the same 5,746.16 because this is the cycle's first report, so period equals year-to-date; that coincidence is not a cumulative reading and Box C is never summed as an increment. The summary ladder closes on its own terms: A 0 + B 5746.16 = F 5746.16, and F - D = 0 = the printed Balance at Close.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' = 5746.16 on the p4 Summary Page, which is also Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 5746.16' and its 'Total Expenditures Made $ 5746.16'
expenditures.detail: 7 Schedule B rows sum to 708.63 + 2500.00 + 1092.86 + 58.21 + 456.09 + 411.84 + 518.53 = 5,746.16 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = Box D. Box E (YTD) prints the same figure and is never summed as an increment. Note the two sides are EQUAL on this filing (5,746.16 on each) because the campaign was funded by one self-contribution and spent to zero — that identity is a property of the document, not a transcription artifact, and each side was still reconciled against its OWN printed anchors.
